_comment: Config for the HOSTED multi-tenant deployment that serves *.all-ai-network.org. Every chapter is served from this one build, so the identity must come from the hostname (see canonicalSlug in src/main.ts) and the content from the dashboard bundle. Everything here is therefore deliberately BLANK: the template's sample officers, events and copy are fallbacks, and on a shared deployment a fallback is somebody else's chapter showing Alex Johnson as its president. A hostname that matches no chapter gets the holding page, which is the correct answer.
